capabilities: Chat with multiple LLM providers (API, local, and CLI backends)
Read, search, and edit vault notes through function calling with confirmation dialogs
Build multi-step automated workflows from 25 node types, including AI decision branches
Run local vector semantic search (RAG) over the vault with hybrid BM25+vector retrieval
Hold live voice conversations with Gemini or OpenAI
extras: Desktop only; mobile users are pointed to the separate Gemini Helper plugin. Discord and Kakeratta connections were moved out to the LLM Connect Hub plugin. Cloud APIs incur charges; web search fees from Tavily/Brave are separate from token costs. Forgetting the encryption password makes encrypted files unrecoverable. Edit history is memory-only and cleared on restart; Obsidian's built-in file recovery covers persistent versioning.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so users must piece together separate tools to chat with LLMs, edit notes via AI, and search their vault semantically.

relations.evidence: Discord integration has been separated from LLM Hub into the LLM Connect Hub Obsidian plugin.
Dashboard functionality is provided by the separate Dashboard Hub plugin.
AI Discussion is provided by the separate Discussion Hub plugin.
Install speech-popup and a microphone button appears above the send button.
Built-in skills - Obsidian-specific knowledge (Markdown, Canvas, Bases) included out of the box. Based on kepano/obsidian-skills
Desktop only (for mobile, see Gemini Helper)
Models contributed by Gemini Helper and Local LLM Hub can participate in the same discussion.

requires.name: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, or Grok API key
Local LLM server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, AnythingLLM, OpenCode) or CLI tool (Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex)
Tavily or Brave Search key for external web search

summary: Multi-provider AI assistant that adds LLM chat, vault-editing tools, workflow automation, voice conversation, and local semantic search (RAG) to Obsidian.
